doc: Sets the CD-audio attenuator volume via CdMix: when a0==1, arms availability flag via func_8005A3E0, sets all four CdlATV channels to 0x4F, and updates D_800847D0.flags1 (clear bit 0x10, set bit 0x20); otherwise disarms via func_8005A3D4, sets L/R channels (val0,val2) to 0x7F and cross channels (val1,val3) to 0, and updates flags1 the opposite way (clear 0x20, set 0x10). Always finishes by calling CdMix(&vol).
